findings.summary: The narrow fix does what review 1 asked for. A tab that has signed out no longer POSTs logout on a passive check, so it cannot revoke a newer session that shares the cookie. The React/HTTP/PGlite regression test is real, it would fail on the 606e8c5 code (focus used to POST /adult/logout), and the contract records the timing/fault channel and the cookie interoperability limit as open, not approved. The stale-report notice is fixed too. However, removing the passive logout also removed the only retry path when an explicit Sign out fails. A focus event, or the Retry session check button, now switches the error state to signed-out without any server confirmation and hides the retry Sign out button. So the claim that explicit logout behaviour is unchanged is not true, and the failure path is not tested.

findings.title: Failed explicit sign-out flips to signed-out with no server check
findings.problem: When the logout POST fails, signOut() shows phase 'error' with 'Local sign-out could not be confirmed… Retry sign out before leaving this shared browser' and offers Retry session check and Sign out buttons. suppressRestore is already true at that point. Any later focus, pageshow or visibility event, or a click on 'Retry session check', runs revalidate(). That now returns {status:'signed_out'} locally with no request, and line 63 maps 'error' to 'signed-out'. The page then shows data-phase=signed-out and the Join form, and the Sign out retry button disappears, while the server session cookie is still valid on what may be a shared browser. Reloading would show the account as restricted again. Before this patch, the suppressed passive check re-POSTed logout: success led to a truthful signed-out state and failure kept the error. The patch therefore removes the retry for failed explicit sign-out, contrary to the report's claim that explicit logout is unchanged and to the card's requirement for meaningful failure handling. The new test covers only the path where logout succeeds.
findings.fix_check: After a failed logout, passive checks and Retry session check must not move the page from 'error' to 'signed-out' unless a logout has been confirmed. For example, record a logoutConfirmed ref and short-circuit only when it is set, or keep the 'error' phase and the Sign out button, without revoking newer sessions without being asked. Add an actual React/HTTP test that makes /adult/logout fail once and then dispatches focus. It must assert that the phase stays 'error', the Sign out button is still present, and no extra logout POST is sent. Then an explicit Sign out retry must succeed. Keep the existing two-tab test passing.

findings.title: Regression test writes a transpiled module into the app/ source tree
findings.problem: The test writes app/.adult-passive-test.mjs with the 'wx' flag and deletes it in finally. If the process is killed partway, an untracked file is left in app/, and the next run then fails on the 'preserve existing owned-test filename' assertion. This is harmless for correctness but makes the test fragile and touches the source directory.
findings.fix_check: Write the transpiled module to a temp directory with resolution configured for react imports, or document the stale-file recovery. Optional.
